name: Sony Xperia XA2 (H3113, H3123, H3133, H4113, H4133)
_comment: Shipped device profile: measured corrections for this camera module (docs/DEVICE-XA2.md). One camera module for every XA2 variant. Best with the Sony v16 vendor binaries (full 5984x3392 JPEG). A key in your own override-hal.json replaces the same key here.
